message.content:
The value of a U.S. dollar relative to the British pound fluctuates daily.  
As of the most recent market data (late 2023 – early 2024), the exchange rate has been roughly:

| Currency | Approximate Rate |
|----------|------------------|
| 1 USD → 0.78 GBP |

Using that rate:

\[
20\ \text{USD} \times 0.78\ \frac{\text{GBP}}{\text{USD}} \approx 15.6\ \text{GBP}
\]

So **$20 is about £15.60**.

> **Note:** Exchange rates change constantly. For an exact, up‑to‑date conversion you should check a reliable financial source (e.g., a bank, a currency‑conversion website, or a financial API) at the time of your transaction.
